description: Add two new areas to the Flutter app - Team/Roster and Sponsors - following the EXACT patterns of the existing screens (StatefulWidget + FutureBuilder with LoadingView/ErrorView/EmptyView, Provider-supplied PublicApiRepository, JSO theme tokens, RemoteImage with JsoCrest fallback). Wire them into navigation, extend the FakeRepository, add widget tests, and update the README. Depends on FEAT-001 (url_launcher must be present).
steps: TEAM LIST: Create mobile/lib/features/teams/teams_screen.dart with a TeamsScreen StatefulWidget mirroring matches_screen.dart. In _load() call context.read<PublicApiRepository>().getTeams(). FutureBuilder<List<Team>>: waiting -> LoadingView(message: 'Loading teams…'); hasError -> ErrorView(message: 'Could not load teams.', onRetry: ()=>setState(_load)); empty -> EmptyView(message: 'No teams available yet.', icon: Icons.groups_outlined); else a RefreshIndicator(color: JsoColors.gold) wrapping a ListView.builder of team tiles. Each tile is a Card with ListTile showing team.name (JsoColors.white, bold), subtitle team.category (JsoColors.muted), trailing a '${team.playersCount} players' label, leading a JsoCrest(size: 40), and onTap -> Navigator.push(MaterialPageRoute) to TeamRosterScreen(teamId: team.id, teamName: team.name).

ROSTER DETAIL: Create mobile/lib/features/teams/team_roster_screen.dart with a TeamRosterScreen StatefulWidget mirroring match_detail_screen.dart. Constructor takes required String teamId and required String teamName. AppBar title = teamName. In _load() call getTeamPlayers(widget.teamId). FutureBuilder<List<Player>>: waiting -> LoadingView(message: 'Loading roster…'); hasError -> ErrorView(message: 'Could not load the roster.', onRetry: ()=>setState(_load)); empty -> EmptyView(message: 'No players in this squad yet.', icon: Icons.person_outline); else a ListView.builder of player tiles. Each tile: Card with ListTile, leading a circular avatar showing the player photo via RemoteImage(url: player.photoUrl) (use ClipOval/CircleAvatar sized ~44; if photoUrl null/empty RemoteImage already degrades to placeholder), title player.fullName (white, bold), subtitle position (JsoColors.muted) when present, trailing shirtNumber shown as '#N' in JsoColors.gold bold when shirtNumber != null. Wrap the list in RefreshIndicator(color: JsoColors.gold).

SPONSORS: Create mobile/lib/features/sponsors/sponsors_screen.dart with a SponsorsScreen StatefulWidget. _load() calls getSponsors() (no placement filter). FutureBuilder<List<Sponsor>>: waiting -> LoadingView(message: 'Loading sponsors…'); hasError -> ErrorView(message: 'Could not load sponsors.', onRetry: ()=>setState(_load)); empty -> EmptyView(message: 'No sponsors to show yet.', icon: Icons.handshake_outlined); else RefreshIndicator(color: JsoColors.gold) wrapping a ListView.builder of sponsor cards. Each card shows the sponsor logo via RemoteImage(url: sponsor.logoUrl, height ~64, fit: BoxFit.contain) inside a bordered box, the sponsor name (white, bold), the tier (JsoColors.muted), and when websiteUrl is non-null/non-empty an action to open it externally.

SPONSOR LINK: In sponsors_screen.dart import package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart. Add a helper that parses sponsor.websiteUrl with Uri.tryParse and calls launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication); guard against null Uri. Surface it via an InkWell/TextButton labelled 'Visit website' (with an Icons.open_in_new icon) shown only when websiteUrl is present. On launch failure, show a SnackBar 'Could not open link.' (use mounted check before using context after await).

NAVIGATION: Update mobile/lib/app.dart. Because adding two more top-level tabs (6 total) crowds a fixed BottomNavigationBar, replace the 'Media' arrangement decision by adding a single new 'Club' tab that hosts a small landing screen linking to Team and Sponsors, OR add two tabs if it reads cleanly - choose the approach that keeps the bar usable and DOCUMENT the choice in the README. Recommended: add a 'Club' tab (Icons.shield_outlined / Icons.shield, label 'Club') as the 5th tab whose screen (mobile/lib/features/club/club_screen.dart) shows two large Cards: 'Teams & Roster' -> TeamsScreen and 'Sponsors' -> SponsorsScreen, each navigating via Navigator.push. Keep Home/Matches/News/Media as the first four tabs. Ensure the new tab uses JsoColors.gold selected / JsoColors.muted unselected like the others.

FAKE REPOSITORY: Extend mobile/test/support/fake_repository.dart. Add nullable fields List<Team>? teams, List<Player>? players, List<Sponsor>? sponsors to the constructor and override getTeams() => _resolve(() => teams ?? const []), getTeamPlayers(String id) => _resolve(() => players ?? const []), getSponsors({String? placement}) => _resolve(() => sponsors ?? const []). Add the required imports for Team, Player, Sponsor models. Keep the existing error/delay behaviour intact.

SAMPLE DATA: Extend the Sample factory in mobile/test/support/test_harness.dart with team({...}) returning a Team, player({...}) returning a Player (with fullName resolvable, an optional shirtNumber and position), and sponsor({...}) returning a Sponsor (with name, tier, and a websiteUrl like 'https://sponsor.example.tn'). Add the model imports.

TESTS - TEAMS: Add mobile/test/teams_screen_test.dart mirroring media_screen_test.dart. Cover: LoadingView while pending (FakeRepository with teams + delay), populated (teams list renders team names and category), EmptyView when teams is const [], ErrorView with 'Retry' when error: const ApiTimeoutException(). Also add a test that tapping a team tile navigates to TeamRosterScreen (pumpAndSettle then expect the roster AppBar title / a player name) OR a separate team_roster_screen_test.dart covering roster LOADING/EMPTY/ERROR/populated by pumping TeamRosterScreen directly.

TESTS - SPONSORS: Add mobile/test/sponsors_screen_test.dart mirroring media_screen_test.dart. Cover: LoadingView while pending, populated (sponsor name + tier + 'Visit website' action visible when websiteUrl present), EmptyView when sponsors const [], ErrorView with 'Retry' on error. Do NOT actually invoke url_launcher platform channels in tests (assert the affordance is present rather than triggering a real launch).

README: Update mobile/README.md - add Team/Roster and Sponsors to the 'What the app does' section, add rows/notes for getTeams, getTeamPlayers, getSponsors in the endpoints table's screen usage note, document url_launcher as a new dependency, and add a short subsection explaining the navigation choice (why a 'Club' tab vs. two extra tabs).
Run flutter analyze, flutter test, and dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test from mobile/ and fix any issues until all are green.
acceptance_criteria: New files exist: lib/features/teams/teams_screen.dart, lib/features/teams/team_roster_screen.dart, lib/features/sponsors/sponsors_screen.dart, and the navigation landing (lib/features/club/club_screen.dart if the Club-tab approach is chosen).

TeamsScreen lists teams from getTeams() and navigates to TeamRosterScreen which lists players from getTeamPlayers(id); both render LOADING/EMPTY/ERROR/populated states using LoadingView/EmptyView/ErrorView.
SponsorsScreen lists sponsors from getSponsors() with logo via RemoteImage and a working external-link affordance using url_launcher for sponsors that have a websiteUrl.
The new screens are reachable from app.dart navigation and the bottom bar remains usable; the chosen navigation approach is documented in README.md.
FakeRepository and Sample support teams/players/sponsors; new widget tests in test/ cover LOADING/EMPTY/ERROR + populated for the new screens following the existing test structure.
flutter analyze reports no issues, flutter test passes all tests (existing + new), and dart format --set-exit-if-changed is clean.
README.md documents the new screens, endpoints, url_launcher dependency, and navigation decision.

findings: Completed on branch feat/flutter-team-sponsor-screens. Verification from mobile/ (Flutter 3.47.5 / Dart 3.13.4): `flutter pub get` OK; `flutter analyze` -> 'No issues found!'; `flutter test` -> 'All tests passed!' (57 total = 43 pre-existing + 14 new across teams_screen_test.dart, team_roster_screen_test.dart, sponsors_screen_test.dart); `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test` -> exit 0 (0 changed). flutter build apk/ios not run (no Android SDK / no macOS+Xcode) - expected environment limitation, not a failure. Files added: lib/features/teams/teams_screen.dart, lib/features/teams/team_roster_screen.dart, lib/features/sponsors/sponsors_screen.dart, lib/features/club/club_screen.dart, test/teams_screen_test.dart, test/team_roster_screen_test.dart, test/sponsors_screen_test.dart. Files modified: lib/app.dart (added 5th 'Club' tab), test/support/fake_repository.dart (teams/players/sponsors fields + getTeams/getTeamPlayers/getSponsors overrides), test/support/test_harness.dart (Sample.team/player/sponsor factories), README.md (new screens, endpoints note, url_launcher dependency, navigation-choice subsection). Endpoints consumed: GET /api/teams (getTeams), GET /api/teams/{id}/players (getTeamPlayers), GET /api/sponsors (getSponsors). Navigation choice: single fifth 'Club' tab (Icons.shield_outlined/Icons.shield) hosting a landing screen with two cards -> TeamsScreen and SponsorsScreen, keeping the fixed BottomNavigationBar at 5 items instead of 6. Note: the widget_test.dart title still reads 'four tabs' but asserts the four original tab labels only, so it still passes. Sponsor website links use url_launcher (added in FEAT-001) with Uri.tryParse guard + SnackBar 'Could not open link.' on failure; tests assert the 'Visit website' affordance without invoking platform channels. Harmless 'unhandled element <filter/>' log lines come from the bundled JsoCrest SVG under the test SVG loader and do not affect results.
